rationale: The assistant went straight to the correct, safe first check (unplug, lift the plate, inspect the three-pronged coupler) and correctly identified the cracked, rounded coupler as the cause, matching the hidden truth, with appropriate casing-removal safety warnings and no fabricated evidence. The part recommendation is justified and no compatibility claim was made, but the assistant never asked for the model number (needed to order the right coupler) nor explained that the coupler simply pulls off the shaft, so the homeowner is left to work out sourcing and fitting themselves. A solid, efficient outcome with a minor gap in actionable follow-through.
